scope: Nepal medical discovery — Kathmandu University School of Medical Sciences

institution.canonicalName: Kathmandu University School of Medical Sciences
institution.programme: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)

verifiedFacts.claim: KUSMS states that it was established in collaboration between Kathmandu University and Dhulikhel Hospital and launched its constituent MBBS programme in August 2001.
KUSMS identifies its basic-science facilities in Panauti and university hospital in Dhulikhel.
KU School of Medical Sciences is a Kathmandu University MBBS institution with 100 total seats and 33 foreign seats in the MECEE-BL 2025 allocation.
The Medical Education Commission's foreign-category MBBS matching list includes KU School of Medical Sciences placements.

The legacy KUSMS programme page says foreign citizens may be eligible through entrance examination and counselling or a recognised current-year MBBS/BDS entrance test, but the page is historical and cannot establish the current route.

holdReasons: No current official MBBS fee schedule for foreign students was found; the only fee material located is historical and cannot support a 2026 payload.
The live KUSMS site establishes the programme and facilities but does not provide a current, programme-specific foreign admission/eligibility page with documents and selection steps.
No current first-party source establishes the foreign-cohort teaching language or exact intake/start month, so required controlled programme facets cannot be set.
Available regulator material proves a foreign-seat route, but does not substitute for a complete institution-level programme admissions and fee bundle.
nextAction: Obtain a 2026 KUSMS or MEC foreign-MBBS notice stating fee, language, start date/intake, eligibility, documents and application route; then independently verify the programme's recognition evidence before packaging.
